headline: Shaily Engineering Plastics slides 2.7% even after 36% rise this year, SBI Securities rates it Buy

modes.bear: The 2.73% share fall shows short‑term weakness, and without a disclosed target price the rally may stall.
modes.bull: SBI Securities' Buy rating and projected 15% upside indicate strong upside potential even after the 2.7% price dip.
modes.simple: Shaily Engineering Plastics stock dropped about 2.7% to ₹3,034, but it’s already up 36% this year. SBI Securities still recommends buying and sees further gains, though no price target is given.

summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics shares fell 2.73% to ₹3,034.65 on Monday. The stock has risen about 36% so far in 2026. SBI Securities maintains a Buy rating and expects an additional 15% upside, though no target price is disclosed. The move may affect investors holding the stock or considering exposure to the engineering plastics sector. Retail investors should note the short‑term dip against a strong year‑to‑date performance.
why_it_matters: Short‑term dip may affect your holdings
winners_losers: Buy rating helps buyers / dip hurts sellers
